parsed.explanation: No visitor-facing criminalisation, border, facility or police targeting is documented; progressive rulings and third-gender recognition are climate signals, not visitor protections. But visibly trans people are reported discriminated against in public spaces and government institutions and exposed to physical and sexual harassment, with recent anti-LGBTQ political hostility and threats. Recourse is uneven—courts can help, but local implementation, civic support and outside-capital safety appear weak. Consequences if outed are likely serious harassment or denial of services, not prosecution or killing. This sits in elevated risk, just above high risk, given thin evidence and uncertain exposure.
